contract.description: (2023) A chef services provider is buying direct and wondering if you're interested?

contract.name: Toy Builders
contract.description: (2020) Toy sales are off the charts this year with manufacturers scrambling to buy raw materials!

contract.name: Long Distance Gifts
contract.description: (2023) For those living on the moon it is time to send gifts home, most go by quantum teleport, but some need old fashioned rockets, and those need fuel!

contract.name: Alt Fertilizer
contract.description: The search for better fertilizers has led one producer to figure out a formula that uses Super Material eggs! Long term contracts are out.

contract.name: Easter Egg Shortage
contract.description: (2019) With so many planned easter eggs hunts around the galaxy, there is a shortage. We need your help!

contract.name: Spring Break
contract.description: (2022) Spring break destinations are different now - this year the top pick is the Moon! Starlines are putting in their fuel orders.

contract.name: Indihenapolis 500
contract.description: After weeks of testing, qualifying, and racing, the amount of new parts needed for the racing series has them looking for extra suppliers!

contract.name: Supermarket Refill
contract.description: (2020) With so many restaurants closed, supermarkets weren't ready for Edible Egg demand for Mother's day omelettes!

contract.name: 2020 Hangover
contract.description: (2021) Is it possible to have a hangover from a year? Doctors are prescribing medical eggs to patients with mysterious headaches and nausea.

contract.name: Summer Jump
contract.description: Summer Diets are starting early this year and more Superfood farmers are needed!

contract.name: Cicada Escape
contract.description: (2021) With Trillions of Cicadas descending on the North Eastern US, millions flee to the quietest place possible... The Moon.

contract.name: Best Moments
contract.description: (2023) Folks are powering up the Tachyon Tube to look back on their favorite memories from the last year - demand is off the charts!

contract.name: ESB
contract.description: New Egg Strand Board "ESB" made from the newly engineered Wood Egg is seeing huge demand, new farmers needed!

contract.name: Ouch!
contract.description: (2018) With all those new power tools out there, there are lots of minor injuries. First Aid!

contract.name: Space Food 2.0
contract.description: (2020) Engineered foods based on Superfood eggs are in mass production for deep space travel. Ingredients needed!

contract.name: Cinco de Oh-no
contract.description: (2019) Cinco de Mayo celebrators partied a little too hard and have depleted pain killer supplies, time to restock!

contract.name: CleanX
contract.description: (2019) To make room for more satellites, we need to clean up space! Over 500,000 pieces of space trash need to be pulled back to earth. So we're building a Graviton Canon!

contract.name: Battery Rush
contract.description: As battery subsidies look to be coming to an end, orders have doubled to beat the deadline!

contract.name: Study Diet
contract.description: A seemingly limitless number of tests are being taken: SAT, ACT, AP, LSAT, ETC. The latest prep fad is a Superfood Egg diet. Stores are sold out!

contract.name: 3D Printing
contract.description: (2019) 3D printing is blowing up and there are filament shortages all over, Super Material eggs are needed!

contract.name: European Heat
contract.description: Scorching heat in Europe coupled with the States had depleted fusion reactor fuels. New orders are in!

contract.name: Last Minute
contract.description: (2018) More fireworks are needed ASAP!

contract.name: Tachy-gone
contract.description: (2020) "Time tourism" broke all records this memorial day depleting tachyon egg inventories, time to help stock back up!

contract.name: Season Supplies
contract.description: As we move into what is predicted to be a significant "fire season" orders for Flame Retardant eggs are surging!

contract.name: LEGO Tower!
contract.description: (2019) Everyone is building LEGO towers. Super Material eggs are needed to form all the bricks! (download LEGO Tower today!)

contract.name: Eggclipse
contract.description: (2022) Watching the Eclipse from space was so popular this year, multiple space tourism companies need their fuel refilled!

contract.name: Egg Days
contract.description: In the after glow of Egg Day, Edible egg demand is remaining high with buyers even offering incentives

contract.name: Heat Waves
contract.description: (2019) Heat waves are being reported all over the planet, help everyone cool off!

contract.name: Power's Out
contract.description: (2024) Storms battering parts of the country are leading to sold out home Fusion Egg generators, additional fuel is needed!

contract.name: Summer Nesting
contract.description: Home improvement season is in full swing with DIYer and pros emptying store shelves of the #1 building material

contract.name: Bake Sale
contract.description: (2022) The world's largest school district is having the world's largest Bake Sale to solve budget issues. They need supplies!

contract.name: Hot Fireworks
contract.description: (2020) With a surge in at-home fireworks shows, burn treatments are flying off the shelves, help restock!

contract.name: Quantum Shelf
contract.description: Advances is quantum field technology allowed the creation of the quantum shelf with 10x storage. Supply contracts are out!

contract.name: Where do the Children Play?
contract.description: A play-structure manufacturer is revolutionizing playground equipment with advanced materials, they are looking for a supplier.

contract.name: Genetic Haircut
contract.description: A new whimsical gene therapy takes hair style out of the salon and into the lab. One pill gets you a new color and style!

contract.name: Tachyon Film
contract.description: A new camera allows for the capture of images at set points in time allowing for long lost photos to be recreated. Demand is surging!

contract.name: Heat Escape
contract.description: As heatwaves grip the northern hemisphere, a new approach to beating the heat has emerged, the vacuum of space!

contract.name: Extra Fitness
contract.description: (2021) After an unusually sedentary year, markets can't keep up with the demand for health foods as summer approaches!

contract.name: Space Land
contract.description: An entertainment company is starting its most ambitious project yet: an amusement park in space. Supplies are needed!

contract.name: Omegga 3
contract.description: (2023) As Omega 3 rich diets gain popularity, Superfood eggs are seen as a top breakfast, orders are surging

contract.name: Compute
contract.description: With the exponentially increasing need for compute, a new specialized raw material Egg has been developed, the first orders are in!

contract.name: Antisocial Media
contract.description: A breakthrough Medical Egg based drug cures many mental illnesses simply by making the patient repulsed by social media.

contract.name: Quantum Compost
contract.description: With the leaves falling, compost bins are overflowing, until now. The manufacturers of Quantum Compost bins need supplies!

contract.name: Fusion Frenzy
contract.description: (2021) A recent oil pipeline hijacking has lead to a spike in Fusion Car sales and subsequent fuel demand!

contract.name: Super Merch
contract.description: As vendors strive to be the one stop shop for all their client's merch manufacturing needs, they're needing to lean on more advanced materials.

contract.name: Anti-Tardy
contract.description: Tardies are a thing of the past with these 5 minute literal time savers, you'll never be late to school again!

contract.name: heNvidia
contract.description: heNvidia has a new AI chip headed for mass production and they have calibrated their equipment to use egg supplies!

contract.name: Carbhen Sequestration
contract.description: An eccentric billionaire is hoarding wood eggs due to their unintended efficient capture and store of carbon!

contract.name: Chocolate Blast
contract.description: Despite all market research, Chocolate reins supreme as the #1 Halloween Candy, with suppliers scrapping for more, will you help?

contract.name: Fusion Sauna
contract.description: Self contained Fusion Egg powered saunas are taking off as the evidence of the health benefits of this treatment pile up!

contract.name: Carbon Karts
contract.description: An indoor kart racing league is building their next-gen karts out of CF, and they're looking for a longtime supplier!

contract.name: Egg Sandwich
contract.description: This ski season, the popularity of this warm high protein lunch is straining egg supplies. New producers are needed!

contract.name: PC Build
contract.description: Desktop PC components are expected to be a huge hit this holiday as the trend of building your own gains momentum!

contract.name: Quantum Slopes
contract.description: An innovate ski resort is at it again, this time phase shifting entire runs so a skier or group can appear to have the run to themselves!

contract.name: Diet Shift
contract.description: (2023) Food suppliers are getting ahead of the diet shift that always comes after Memorial day, and bonuses are being offered for Super Food Egg contracts!

contract.name: Montessori Christmas
contract.description: Montessori toys are trending this year, turns out they are just normal toys but made of wood that cost 4x as much!

contract.name: Custom Christmas
contract.description: One-off custom 3d printed Christmas toys are all the rage, and perfectly timed with this new filament egg formula!

contract.name: Ode To Time
contract.description: (2021) On the longest day of the year (northern hemisphere), it has become tradition to celebrate time itself with various Tachyon Egg activities!

contract.name: Quantum Storm
contract.description: Quantum pump technology is being applied at an industrial scale to manage storm flooding, the first test is coming soon!

contract.name: Inference
contract.description: Big orders for AI chips tailored for inference are being placed for 2026. Fabs need more raw materials!

contract.name: Giant TVs
contract.description: The TV size race is seemingly unstoppable, a new technology makes use of Super Material eggs for 120" thermally efficient panels!

contract.name: Hot Chocolate
contract.description: With ski season fully underway and temps dropping, Hot Chocolate is surging in popularity unlike any year before!

contract.name: Choc Shock II
contract.description: (2023) To everyone's surprise, chocolate was the top Father's Day gift this year - depleting supplies - orders are in!
